sources.notes: Revisited on 2026-10-21. Egypt and Ecuador retain 90-day entries. UAE appears with 30-day visa-free treatment on printed page 523; footnote f on page 528 says travel permits are not issued visas. This conflicts with the current UAE MOFA Macao Visa Required card; the UAE rule is manual review.

sources.authority: Macao SAR Government Portal, source: Identification Services Bureau
sources.title: Macao SAR Passport holders are granted visa-free access to UAE
sources.notes: Read on 2026-10-21. The Macao SAR Government's 2019-06-27 notice says it was officially informed by the UAE Government that Macao SAR passport holders were granted visa-free access for a maximum 30-day stay. This is direct official counter-evidence to the current UAE MOFA card, not a resolution of that current conflict.

sources.authority: Instituto Nacional de Migración, Mexico
sources.title: Countries and regions requiring a visa to travel to Mexico
sources.notes: Re-read official INM page on 2026-10-21, HTTP 200: China is in the visa-required list and unpaid visitor activities are specified. This general requirement is read together with the current consular exemptions, not as an exceptionless nationality rule.

sources.authority: Consulate General of Mexico in Hong Kong
sources.title: Mexican Visa Exemptions
sources.notes: Read official consular text on 2026-10-21, HTTP 200: HK/Macao passports up to 90 days; any foreign national with listed valid multiple-entry visas or permanent-residence documents has an independent tourist/business exemption up to 180 days. ABTC and crew are separate branches. Later repeated reads had transport EOF; no certificate verification was disabled.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Brazil
sources.title: Visa requirements by country — list of countries
sources.notes: Read current official MFA country-list page on 2026-10-21, HTTP 200. The China paragraph limits exemptions to diplomatic/official passports and requires a visa for other passport types; Hong Kong has its own ordinary SAR passport entry. Read together with the HK consulate VIVIS and SAR-document exclusions.

sources.authority: Consulate General of Brazil in Hong Kong, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.title: Tourist Visa
sources.notes: Read official HK consular Tourist Visa text on 2026-10-21, HTTP 200, page last updated 2025-04-14. VIVIS covers unpaid tourism and visitor activities; HK and Macao SAR passports exempt up to 90 days, while HK Document of Identity and Macao Travel Permit require entry visas. This consular application jurisdiction requires HKID/Macao BIR; it is not a global residence requirement for every visitor.

sources.authority: Consulate General of Peru in London, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.title: Tourism Visas
sources.notes: Current London consular page HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 confirms Hong Kong tourist exemption and the six-month qualifying-visa route for Chinese nationals. Read together with the normative ordinary-passport table, whose PRC footnote b additionally provides permanent-residence eligibility; the web paragraph is not an exclusive full list.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Colombia
sources.title: Entry to Colombia and Courtesy Visa Information
sources.notes: Official PDF HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21; SHA256 8A0D9ACAEB5AB93B16938ADFA4C61B2FD12534F22A7389C75CC7B9A29D80E517. Visually checked pp.1-2: Hong Kong SAR short-stay waiver, PRC US/Schengen conditional waiver, and separate nationality-neutral Pacific Alliance/Andean permanent-resident exemption. Less than 90 days is not recorded as an inclusive 90-day grant.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Chile, Consular Services
sources.title: Visas para ingresar a Chile
sources.notes: Read current page and its published ArancelesVisas.class script on 2026-10-21. The script explicitly loads info_visas.json and notas_visas.json; eligibility comes from visa SI/NO plus the exact country notes, not the location selector or zero tariffs.

sources.authority: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, Argentina
sources.title: Regimen de Visas
sources.notes: Revisited on 2026-10-21. The current DNM matrix marks REPUBLICA POPULAR CHINA as REQUIERE VISA under Pasaporte Ordinario (Turista), with HABILITADO in the Visa EEUU and Green CARD columns. HONG KONG (REPUBLICA CHINA) and MACAO (REPUBLICA CHINA) have no ordinary-tourist REQUIERE VISA marker; the matrix gives no stay period, so their duration comes only from passport-specific cross-checks or agreements.

sources.authority: Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros, Argentina
sources.title: Resolución 316/2025 — ingreso sin visado consular argentino ni AVE
sources.notes: Read current official text on 2026-10-21. Article 1 covers PRC nationals with ordinary passports and a valid/current US visa for a similar migration category; tourists and business visitors are limited to 30 days. Article 2 bars category change and allows one similar-period extension subject to DNM review. Those outside the stated exemption must apply for a consular visa.

sources.authority: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, Argentina
sources.title: Autorización de Viaje Electrónica (AVE)
sources.notes: Read current DNM page on 2026-10-21. It states that Chinese citizens do not need AVE for tourism or business with a US visa or Green Card. The page's Green Card statement is not expanded here into a general consular-visa exemption; Resolución 316/2025 specifically describes a valid US visa in a similar category.

sources.authority: Gobierno de la República Argentina
sources.title: Turistas de Argentina y de la Región China de Macao podrán viajar sin visado
sources.notes: Read official Argentina government announcement on 2026-10-21. It states a 30-consecutive-day visa exemption for tourism and business for Macao residents of Chinese nationality holding valid passports issued by Macao SAR; extension may be requested. Do not broaden beyond the stated document and eligibility scope.

sources.authority: Direcção dos Serviços de Identificação, Macao SAR
sources.title: Visa-free access or visa-on-arrival for Macao SAR passport holders — Argentina
sources.notes: Read the official DSI Argentina detail page on 2026-10-21. For holders of a Macao SAR passport it lists Argentina, a maximum stay of 30 days, and the remark 'Visa-Waiver Program between Macao SAR Government and related countries or regions'. DSI advises checking destination-authority requirements and notes that final stay is determined at entry.

sources.authority: Hong Kong Immigration Department
sources.title: Visa-free Access or Visa-on-arrival for HKSAR passport list
sources.notes: Current official PDF updated 2026-10-16. Argentina is listed for up to 90 days; Saudi Arabia is entry 138 and Remark 30 names six designated arrival points, single/multiple-entry options and stay limits, plus the pre-travel eVisa alternative. The list combines visa-free access and visa-on-arrival, is general reference only, and says the destination authority determines entry and actual stay; confirm Saudi details with the Saudi Consulate General in Hong Kong.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Uruguay, Consulate General in Hong Kong
sources.title: Visas
sources.notes: The official consular page provides tourist-visa requirements and directs applicants to consult the Uruguayan Ministry of the Interior's Visa Policy for Foreign Nationals before applying, but the reviewed page does not expose a target-passport-specific China, Hong Kong or Macao outcome.

sources.authority: Ministry of the Interior of Uruguay
sources.title: Régimen de visas de admisión
sources.notes: Revisited on 2026-10-21. The current Ministry page retains China ordinary-passport visa/third-country exception, HKSAR passport marking and Macao common-passport exemption footnotes.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Human Mobility of Ecuador
sources.title: Lista de países que deben presentar visa al ingresar al Ecuador
sources.notes: Revisited on 2026-10-21. The official entry-visa list remains accessible and includes República Popular China; it does not separately identify Hong Kong or Macao SAR passports.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Human Mobility of Ecuador
sources.title: Acuerdo Ministerial No. 0000064
sources.notes: Revisited on 2026-10-21. The official 1 July 2024 ministerial order remains accessible and records the prior visa requirement for nationals of the People's Republic of China, with official/public/diplomatic passport and applicable agreement exceptions.

sources.authority: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government
sources.title: Visa-free arrangement for HKSAR passport holders
sources.notes: The official Hong Kong Government announcement records the Ecuador visa abolition agreement for HKSAR passport holders, stating visa-free access for up to 90 days with effect from 3 October 1999; the current HKSAR Immigration Department table is retained as a cross-check.

sources.authority: Embassy of the Republic of Paraguay in Japan
sources.title: Visa
sources.notes: Read full ordinary-passport sections I, II and III on 2026-10-21, HTTP 200. PRC/HK/Macao are absent from both finite exemption and VOA lists; section III explicitly requires other nationalities to obtain visas before travel. The residence list is consular jurisdiction evidence, not itself a nationality exemption test. Passport six months from entry; no unsupported stay period inferred.

sources.authority: Embassy of Bolivia in London
sources.title: Visa Grupos 1-2-3
sources.notes: Read official embassy page on 2026-10-21, HTTP 200. Under the explicit TOURIST VISA GROUP II heading, the country table lists CHINA (INCLUDING HONG KONG, TAIWAN, MACAO). Application requirements include six-month passport validity and consular appointment. Do not import Group I exemption or Group III stay/fee values into Group II.

sources.authority: Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería, Costa Rica
sources.title: Visas
sources.notes: On 2026-10-21 normal certificate-validated clients returned HTTP 403 / explicit Cloudflare blocked page. No security challenge was bypassed. The currently published directive version was not confirmed; do not renew policies from this router.

sources.authority: Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería / Diario Oficial La Gaceta, Costa Rica
sources.title: Directrices Generales de Visas de Ingreso y Permanencia para No Residentes — AJ-484-11-2025
sources.notes: 2025 dated Gazette PDF remains accessible, HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21; SHA256 6F17796468E1441F560943B67D3483627D852E6ABD76AD15411C8BE29F6434A8. Visually checked physical pp.8/12/15 and full relevant text: group III uses 60 WORKING days after stamping, 180-calendar-day passport validity; Chinese minors have a restricted-commission route. Current central router is blocked, so historical policy check/review dates are NOT renewed.

sources.authority: Consulate General of Colombia in Hong Kong, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.title: 30 frequently asked questions regarding visa applications and issuance for foreigners to Colombia
sources.notes: Current official FAQ HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 confirms Hong Kong passport tourist/transit exemption and Macao baseline visa requirement. The latter must be read with the MFA PDF nationality-neutral permanent-residence exemptions; consular jurisdiction is not an extra residence condition for all travellers.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Peru
sources.title: Requerimientos y exoneración de visas para ciudadanos extranjeros en pasaportes ordinarios
sources.notes: Canonical official PDF downloaded 2026-10-21, HTTP 200; SHA256 EF900088922311992182EEDA5C7FF1487CD75558334B6975DD0B1B0D0D71EE81. Visually checked PDF p.3 PRC SI/NO and footnotes a/b (qualifying six-month visas OR permanent residence), p.5 Hong Kong tourist NO/90 versus business SI, Macao tourist SI and independent Pacific Alliance resident exemption.

sources.authority: Consulate General of India in Hong Kong
sources.title: Indian Visa fee schedule for all nationalities
sources.notes: The former official PDF URL returned 404 on 2026-10-21. Historical dates are retained, but the old fee and three-month single-entry issuance statement are not renewed or used by current rules.

sources.authority: U.S. Department of State
sources.title: Visitor Visa
sources.notes: Read on 2026-10-21. The overview establishes the general visa requirement and distinguishes tourism B-2 from business B-1 or combined B-1/B-2; it does not supply a universal admission duration.

sources.authority: Ministry of Justice, Republic of Korea
sources.title: Notice on Extension of K-ETA Temporary Exemption
sources.notes: Read on 2026-10-21. Notice dated 2025-12-23 extends the existing exemption through 2026-12-31 KST; applications remain voluntary and fee-paying.

sources.authority: Embassy of the Republic of Korea to the Swiss Confederation
sources.title: Notice on Temporary Exemption of K-ETA, updated until 31 December 2026
sources.notes: Direct HTTPS returned 200 on 2026-10-21. The current notice explicitly lists Hong Kong and Macao in its Asia group and extends the temporary exemption through 2026-12-31; it links the Justice Ministry notice.

sources.authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, United Arab Emirates
sources.title: Visa Exemptions for Non Citizen
sources.notes: Read on 2026-10-21. The actual rendered-card HTML explicitly marks PRC and Hong Kong Visa Free and Macao Visa Required; no stay periods are given. Macao conflicts with the official 2025 Macao Yearbook and the Macao Government's 2019 report that the UAE formally notified it of 30-day visa-free entry, so that rule remains manual review.

sources.authority: Department of Immigration, Nepal
sources.title: Countries for tourist visa — public nationality selector API
sources.notes: Read on 2026-10-21. The official public response includes Macao Special Administrative Region of China, code MAC, id 44, blacklisted false. This is application-country evidence, not guaranteed visa issuance, free-visa treatment or entry.

sources.authority: Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs, India
sources.title: Indian Visa Online — authorized entry visa requirement
sources.notes: Read on 2026-10-21. The official portal states foreign nationals entering India require a valid national passport with an applicable mission-issued visa or limited-category eVisa. This does not establish eVisa eligibility for any particular SAR passport, nor replace separate OCI or other status checks.

sources.authority: Embassy of Bangladesh in Beijing
sources.title: Online Visa on Arrival / Transit Visa Application
sources.notes: Read on 2026-10-21 using certificate-validated HTTPS. The embassy directs online visa-on-arrival/transit enquiries and applications to voa.specialbranch.gov.bd. This is an official process link, not nationality eligibility or approval evidence.

sources.title: Official visa country-note definitions
